items.text: Introduced a bill freezing nearly all immigration admissions except tourist visas until a list of restrictions became law, among them limiting family immigration to spouses and minor children, ending the visa lottery, limiting citizenship at birth to children of citizens or permanent residents, and barring noncitizens from means-tested benefits.

Cosponsored from its introduction a bill ending citizenship at birth for children born in the country unless a parent is a citizen, a permanent resident, or serving in the armed forces with legal status. An independent estimate for a similar measure put the births affected at about 255,000 a year, about 0.07 percent of the population.
